card.name: Verbs like occurred after adverse reactions
card.fires_on: The verb 'occur', 'occurred' or 'experienced' right after 'have', 'has', 'may' or 'can', when a warnings section says an adverse reaction happens or has been reported.

modes.label: Patients have experienced
modes.description: 'experienced' after 'have' with patients or a drug name as subject, before a named reaction.
modes.example: Patients treated with POMBILITI have<< experienced>> severe IARs.

modes.label: Reaction may/has occurred
modes.description: 'occur' or 'occurred' after a reaction or lab finding in a warnings list.
modes.example: Tendon rupture has<< occurred>>. Discontinue NEXLETOL at
